title: Director of Operations
text:
**Job Overview**

The Director of Operations provides executive leadership across operations and business management, aligning day-to-day execution with strategic priorities. This role oversees financial and budget management, guides projects and organizational change, and advances process improvement to support effective, sustainable business performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operations management and coordinate business activities.
* Set strategic direction and translate priorities into plans.
* Oversee financial management and budget planning.
* Guide project management from planning through delivery.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency.
* Lead change management and support effective adoption.
* Your impact: Strong operational and financial oversight helps teams use resources effectively and deliver on business priorities.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated capability in operations and business management.
* Executive leadership skills and sound strategic judgment.
* Knowledge of financial management and budget oversight.
* Project management skills, including planning and coordination.
* Ability to assess processes and guide improvements.
* Clear communication and change leadership skills.

Pay: $141,100.00 - $207,800.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Miami Beach, FL 33139
